component.name: CyberSnapper
component.summary: Capture responsive websites and create portfolio-ready mockups

description.p: CyberSnapper is a native website screenshot studio for capturing complete responsive portfolios across desktop, tablet, mobile, and custom viewports.
It keeps untouched source captures and can create polished browser, tablet, and phone presentations locally with configurable scenes and backgrounds.

screenshot.caption: Portfolio presentation scene and frame editor
